title: Datadog closed up 31%+ after reporting Q1 revenue up 32% YoY to $1B and raising its FY revenue forecast, an outlier in the software industry amid the AI boom (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: Datadog closed up 31%+ after reporting Q1 revenue up 32% YoY to $1B and raising its FY revenue forecast, an outlier in the software industry amid the AI boom — Shares of Datadog Inc. popped after the application monitoring software firm crushed Wall Street's expectations …
